paite: Huai khit in Jesu kiang ah Jerusalem a kipan Pharisaite leh laigelhmite ahong pai ua,
heading: Thugousiah Thu A Thuhilhna / (Mar 7.1-13)
english: Then Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem, saying,

paite: "Bangziak a upate thugousiah a na nungzuite talek nak uh ahia? Tanghou anek chiang un akhut uh asil ngei kei uh," achi uhi.
english: “Why do your disciples disobey the tradition of the elders? For they don’t wash their hands when they eat bread.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Nou leng bangziak a na thugousiah ziak ua Pathian thupiak a talek na hi ua?
english: He answered them, “Why do you also disobey the commandment of God because of your tradition?

paite: Pathian in, 'Na nu leh na pa zahtak in, kuapeuh anu hiam apa hiam gensia si ngeingei heh' achi hi.
english: For God commanded, ‘Honor your father and your mother,’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’

paite: Nou bel, 'kuapeuh anu hiam apa hiam kiang a, na hon zatna ding Pathian kiang a piak ahih peuhmah chiang in,
english: But you say, ‘Whoever may tell his father or his mother, “Whatever help you might otherwise have gotten from me is a gift devoted to God,”

paite: anu leh apa azah ding ahi nawn kei,' na chi uhi. Huchi in na thugousiah ziak un Pathian thu bangmah lou na suah uhi.
english: he shall not honor his father or mother.’ You have made the commandment of God void because of your tradition.

paite: Nou lepchiahte, Isai in na tungtang thu uh ana genkhol dik mahmah hi;
english: You hypocrites! Well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,

paite: "Hiai mite'n akam un ahon zah ua, amuk un ahon phat ua, himahleh alungtang un ahon gamlat uh.
english: ‘These people draw near to me with their mouth, and honor me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.

paite: Himahleh, athuhilhna ua mihing thupiak ahilh ziak un ahon biak uh athawn mai ahi," chi in adawng hi.
english: And they worship me in vain, teaching as doctrine rules made by men.’”

paite: Huan mipi asam a akiang uah, "Ngaikhia unla, theisiam un;
heading: Mihingte Ninsakte / (Mar 7.14-23)
english: He summoned the multitude, and said to them, “Hear, and understand.

paite: kam a lut in mihing ahihnin kei a; himahleh kam a pawt, huai ngei in mihing ahihnin zaw hi,” achi hi.
english: That which enters into the mouth doesn’t defile the man; but that which proceeds out of the mouth, this defiles the man.”

paite: Huai lai in anungzuite ahong pai ua, akiang ah, "Pharisaite'n huai thu azak ua alungkimlouhdan uh na thei hia?" achi uhi.
english: Then the disciples came and said to him, “Do you know that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this saying?”

paite: Ama'n, "Kung tengteng ka Pa van a om suan louh bohkhiak in a-om ding.
english: But he answered, “Every plant which my heavenly Father didn’t plant will be uprooted.

paite: Amaute awlmoh kei un; mittaw makai ahi uh; huchi in mittaw in mittaw mah apileh kokhuk ah akekhawm ding uh," chi in adawng hi.
english: Leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.”

paite: Huan Peter in akiang ah, "Huai gentehna thu hon hilhchian in," chi in adong hi.
english: Peter answered him, “Explain the parable to us.”

paite: Ama'n, "Tutan a nou leng thei nai lou lai na hi uh maw?
english: So Jesus said, “Do you also still not understand?

paite: Kam a lut peuhmah gil ah alutsuk a, dailenna ah paihkhiak in a-om chih na thei kei ua hia?
english: Don’t you understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the belly and then out of the body?

paite: Kam a pawtte bel lungtang a kipan a hong pawt ahi ua; huaite ngeingei in mihing ahihnin nak hi.
english: But the things which proceed out of the mouth come out of the heart, and they defile the man.

paite: Lungtang a kipan ngaihtuahna giloute, tualthahna, angkawmna, kingaihna, guktakna, hekna, gensiatna ahong pawt nak hi.
english: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.

paite: Huaite ahi mihing hihnin; khut sil lou a an nek in mi ahihnin kei,” achi hi.
english: These are the things which defile the man; but to eat with unwashed hands doesn’t defile the man.”

paite: Jesu hiai a kipan pawt in Tura leh Sidon uk ah apaita hi.
heading: Zentel Numei Hihdamna / (Mar 7.24-30)
english: Jesus went out from there and withdrew into the region of Tyre and Sidon.

paite: Huan ngai dih, huai gam a kipan Kanaan numei khat ahong pai a, "Toupa, David Tapa, ka tung ah zahngai in, ka tanu dawi in lungkhamhuaipi in ama'n," chi in akikou hi.
english: Behold, a Canaanite woman came out from those borders and cried, saying, “Have mercy on me, Lord, you son of David! My daughter is severely possessed by a demon!”

paite: Ama'n bel kam khat in leng adawng kei hi. Anungzuite'n, "I nung ah akikoukou a, paisak mai in," chi in hong gen uhi.
english: But he answered her not a word. His disciples came and begged him, saying, “Send her away; for she cries after us.”

paite: Ama'n bel, "Israel inkote nam lak a belam mangte kiang lou ngal ah sawl ka hi kei," chi in adawng hi.
english: But he answered, “I wasn’t sent to anyone but the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”

paite: Himahleh numei ahong pai a, "Toupa hon huh in," chi in abia hi.
english: But she came and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, help me.”

paite: Huan ama'n, "Tate tanghou laksak a, uite kiang a paih akilawm kei," chi in adawng hi.
english: But he answered, “It is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”

paite: Numei in, "Toupa, hih zaw ahi tham hi; himahleh, uite'n leng apu uh dohkan a kipan a tanghou nen kia ane zel sam ve ua oi," achi hi.
english: But she said, “Yes, Lord, but even the dogs eat the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.”

paite: Huaitak in Jesu'n akiang ah, "Numei, na ginna thupi na tel e; na deih bangtak in na tung ah om hen," chi in adawng a, huchi in atanu huai hun ngei in adamta hi.
english: Then Jesus answered her, “Woman, great is your faith! Be it done to you even as you desire.” And her daughter was healed from that hour.

paite: Huai a kipan Jesu apai a, Galili tuipi kiang ahong tung a; tang ah apaitou a, huai ah atu hi.
heading: Mi Tampi Hihdamna
english: Jesus departed from there and came near to the sea of Galilee; and he went up on the mountain and sat there.

paite: Huchi in akiang ah mipi tampi ahong ua, khebaite, mittawte, pau theiloute, piangsualte leh midang tampi ahon pi ua, ama'n amaute ana hihdam chiat hi.
english: Great multitudes came to him, having with them the lame, blind, mute, maimed, and many others, and they put them down at his feet. He healed them,

paite: Mipite'n pau theiloute hong pau a, piangsualte hong hoih a, khebaite khe a pai a, mittawte'n hon mutheita uh chih amuh un lamdang asa mahmah ua; huchi in Israel' Pathian aphatta uhi.
english: so that the multitude wondered when they saw the mute speaking, the injured healed, the lame walking, and the blind seeing—and they glorified the God of Israel.

paite: Huchi in Jesu'n anungzuite asam a, "Ka kiang ah mipite ni thum a-omta ua, nek ding bangmah aneih louh ziak un, ka lainat mahmah; an ngawl in ka paikiksak ut kei hi, huchi lou in zaw lamkal ah abahsegawp kha ding uh," achi hi.
heading: Mipi Sangli Vakna / (Mar 8.1-10)
english: Jesus summoned his disciples and said, “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have continued with me now three days and have nothing to eat. I don’t want to send them away fasting, or they might faint on the way.”

paite: Nungzuite'n akiang ah, "Mipi hiai zahzah vahna khop tanghou huai zahzah gamdai ah koi a kipan i mu dia?" achi uhi.
english: The disciples said to him, “Where could we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a multitude?”

paite: Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Tanghou phel bangzah na nei ua? achi hi. Amau akiang ah, phel sagih leh nga neu tawmchik toh," achi uhi.
english: Jesus said to them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven, and a few small fish.”

paite: Huan ama'n lei a tu ding in mipite thu apia a,
english: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;

paite: huan tanghou phel sagih leh ngate ala a, kipahthu gen in, abalkham a, nungzuite kiang ah apia a, huchi in nungzuite'n mipite kiang ah apesawn uhi.
english: and he took the seven loaves and the fish. He gave thanks and broke them, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.

paite: Huan avek un ane ua, avah chiatta ua; akhamval nen uh bawmpi sagih adim hi.
english: They all ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets full of the broken pieces that were left over.

paite: Anete tuh numei leh naupang sim louh in, piching ngen sangli ahi uh.
english: Those who ate were four thousand men, in addition to women and children.

paite: Huan mipite asawlmang nung in long ah Jesu atuang a, Magadan gam atung hi.
english: Then he sent away the multitudes, got into the boat, and came into the borders of Magdala.
